8.6.1.13 Dem_IumprDenomCondStatusType
[SWS_Dem_00944]
Definition of ImplementationDataType Dem_IumprDenom
CondStatusType ⌈
Name
Dem_IumprDenomCondStatusType
Kind
Type
Derived from
uint8
DEM_IUMPR_DEN_
STATUS_NOT_REACHED
0x00
Condition of IUMPR-Denominator
given by IUMPRDenCondId is not
met (yet).
DEM_IUMPR_DEN_
STATUS_REACHED
0x01
Condition of IUMPR-Denominator
given by IUMPRDenCondId is met
DEM_IUMPR_DEN_
STATUS_INHIBITED
0x02
Condition of IUMPR-Denominator
given by IUMPRDenCondId is
inhibited and cannot be reached.
Range
0x03 - 0xFF
reserved
Description
This type contains all possible states of an additional IUMPR denominator condition to be
broadcasted among OBD-relevant ECUs.
Variation
–
Available via
Rte_Dem_Type.h
⌋
